description: This file defines a React component 'ProductsPage' that renders a product grid with search and filter functionalities for an e-commerce frontend. It interacts with an API to fetch product data based on user-specified filters.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Fetches product data from the API based on current search parameters and updates the component's product list.

methods.name: applyFilters
methods.description: Handles form submission to apply search and filter criteria by updating the URL query parameters.
